import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

import app.models  # noqa
from app.db import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app.models.tenant import Tenant
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.tracker import TenantAuditLog
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}, poolclass=StaticPool)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)
session = Session()

def override():
    yield session
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override

client = TestClient(app)

tenant_id = uuid.uuid4()
admin_id = uuid.uuid4()
approver_id = uuid.uuid4()
session.add(Tenant(id=tenant_id, name="Acme", high_risk_threshold=70, created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
session.add(User(id=admin_id, tenant_id=tenant_id, name="Admin", email="admin@acme.test", role="TENANT_ADMIN", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
session.add(User(id=approver_id, tenant_id=tenant_id, name="Appr", email="appr@acme.test", role="APPROVER", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
session.add(TenantAuditLog(id=uuid.uuid4(), tenant_id=tenant_id, log_date_time=now - timedelta(days=1), log_user="Admin", log_action="Created", log_entity="User", details="created user", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
session.add(TenantAuditLog(id=uuid.uuid4(), tenant_id=tenant_id, log_date_time=now, log_user="System", log_action="Updated", log_entity="Integration", details="token expired", created_by=admin_id, updated_by=admin_id))
session.commit()

def hdr(role, uid):
    return {"X-User-Role": role, "X-User-Id": str(uid)}

print("no auth header ->", client.get("/api/v1/settings/audit-log").status_code)
print("wrong role ->", client.get("/api/v1/settings/audit-log", headers=hdr("APPROVER", approver_id)).status_code)
r = client.get("/api/v1/settings/audit-log", headers=hdr("TENANT_ADMIN", admin_id))
print("happy path ->", r.status_code, r.json())
r2 = client.get("/api/v1/settings/audit-log", params={"actionTypeFilter": "Updated"}, headers=hdr("TENANT_ADMIN", admin_id))
print("filtered ->", r2.status_code, r2.json())
import json
spec = app.openapi()
print("in openapi:", "/api/v1/settings/audit-log" in spec["paths"])
print(json.dumps(spec["paths"].get("/api/v1/settings/audit-log"), indent=2)[:800])
print("security schemes:", list(spec["components"]["securitySchemes"].keys()))
EOF
